messages:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a couple of customer infra PRs are stuck in Atlantis 'apply' after ArgoCD post-apply webhooks started timing out this morning. Anyone else seeing this?
ryan: seeing same. GH Actions reported 'job succeeded' but atlantis apply never finished, then argocd shows 'post-sync-hook timeout'.
katie: logs? can you paste the webhook payload/error from ArgoCD?
maya: here’s the failing snippet from argocd-server logs: `PostSyncHook failed: context deadline exceeded (timeout after 30s)`
sam: that matches our hooks hitting a 30s default timeout. We recently added a GitHub Actions step that updates external secrets which is slower now. Hook tries to call GH API and times out.
ryan: interesting — GH Actions update runs as a separate job triggered by the manifest change, which can take >30s for some repos. If ArgoCD waits synchronously it will time out.
maya: idea: make post-sync hook asynchronous (use webhook to queue work) OR bump hook timeout. Thoughts?
katie: prefer async queue. Bumping hides slowness but still blocks rollout when GH rate limits spike. Can we change the hook to POST to /internal/async-exec?
sam: looks feasible. Quick patch: change hook in k8s manifests to call `async-exec.svc.cluster.local:8080/trigger` and return immediately. PR ready for review.
ryan: can you paste the current hook snippet?
maya: current hook config in k8s manifest: ```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: update-external-secrets
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: updater
        image: gh-actions-runner:latest
        command: ["/bin/sh","-c","python sync_secrets.py"]
```
katie: that runs sync inline. Change it to a small curl to the async service and let the job exit quickly.
sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/async-hooks — switched to curl and added an annotation `argocd.argoproj.io/hook-timeout: "60"` while we roll out async.
maya: per atlantis, PR triggers plan then apply. We should ensure Atlantis won't block other applies when a hook job lingers. Maybe set `spec.strategy: Recreate` for the hook Job to avoid multiple parallel hooks?
ryan: Atlantis applies should be fine but ArgoCD holds the sync until hooks complete. For safety, update ArgoCD app annotation `argocd.argoproj.io/hook-timeout: "60"` and also implement the async path — then revert timeout later.
katie: agree. I can review the PR in 15m.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment check — atlantis plan: OK, apply queued.
maya: thanks. After katie approves we'll merge and watch the next PR apply. If anything still hangs, we'll bump to 120s and open an incident. :eyes:
ryan: will monitor ArgoCD syncs and post alerts if hook durations >30s.
katie: approved, left a couple tiny nits.
sam: merged and triggered a test rollout.
infra-bot: argocd: app/infra-app: post-sync-hook triggered -> returned 202 Accepted
maya: seeing the rollout progress, hooks now return quickly. closing this thread, will follow up if any regressions. :white_check_mark:
